S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.

subtypes.Depressed Mood: A persistently sunken mood or feeling of depression.
subtypes.Tearfulness: A state of frequent crying or inability to hold back tears.
subtypes.Sadness: A state where a sad or gloomy mood is maintained continuously.
subtypes.Emptiness: A feeling of inner emptiness or a state of feeling no emotion.
subtypes.Emotional Numbness: A state where emotions feel dulled or paralyzed.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.

subtypes.Chronic Fatigue: Fatigue that persists for a long period even after adequate rest.
subtypes.Physical Fatigue: A state of physical exhaustion where the body feels heavy and easily tires even from minor activities.
subtypes.Mental Fatigue: A state where fatigue accumulates rapidly during the process of thinking or concentrating.
subtypes.Loss of Energy: Difficulty performing daily activities due to a decline in energy and vitality.

S031.name: Diminished_Thinking
S031.description: Diminished ability to think or concentrate, or indecisiveness.

subtypes.Reduced Concentration: Unable to pay attention or maintain focus on specific activities like conversation, reading, or watching TV.
subtypes.Indecisiveness: Extreme difficulty making even minor daily choices (e.g., menu, clothes) and hesitating to make decisions.
subtypes.Subjective Memory Complaints: Complaining of memory decline, such as forgetting where things were placed, due to reduced focus.
subtypes.Clouded Thinking: Thinking feels foggy, dazed, or not clear.

S083.name: Hopelessness
S083.description: A feeling of despair or having no hope for the future.

subtypes.Future Hopelessness: The persistent conviction that the future holds no possibility of improvement.
subtypes.Belief in Impossibility of Improvement: The belief that the current situation will absolutely not get better.
subtypes.Helpless Resignation: A state of helplessness and resignation, believing that nothing will change despite effort.
subtypes.Chronic Pessimism: A persistent tendency to view everything negatively and fail to consider positive possibilities.

patient_info.stressor_event: Major change in living condition (new home, remodeling, deterioration of neighborhood or home)
patient_info.stressor: Ashley and her spouse moved from a quiet rental into a smaller older home near the lab, intending to renovate it into a controlled, low-clutter retreat with space for baking, bonsai, and telescope storage. Delays, noise, and the constant disruption of her carefully organized environment coincided with the start of a low, pessimistic emotional baseline that persisted for 2 years and 2 months, accompanied by fatigue and more difficulty sustaining the precise thinking her research demanded. Her work remained largely intact, but grant drafts took longer, routine decisions felt unusually effortful, and she noticed herself planning less for future travel or stargazing projects. Because she tracks personal habits as carefully as lab variables, Ashley recognized the duration and functional drift herself and arranged a psychiatric consultation through her health plan.

S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.
S024.manifestation: Most days there’s this low, gray mood running in the background, like I can still go to the lab and talk to people, but I don’t really feel light or excited about things like baking or checking the telescope the way I used to.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.
S029.manifestation: I’m here because I feel worn down almost all the time, even after a full night’s sleep, and by the time I’ve handled work and the house clutter I have very little left for anything else.

S031.name: Diminished_Thinking
S031.description: Diminished ability to think or concentrate, or indecisiveness.
S031.manifestation: Tasks that used to be clean and sequential, like revising a grant paragraph or choosing materials for a home repair, now take me longer because my mind feels slower and I keep second-guessing small decisions.

S083.name: Hopelessness
S083.description: A feeling of despair or having no hope for the future.
S083.manifestation: I catch myself assuming the house will never really be settled and that I’m probably just going to keep operating at this reduced level, which makes it hard to plan trips or future stargazing projects.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: I’m still getting my lab work done, but grant drafts and routine project decisions take noticeably longer, and at home I’ve stopped keeping up with the baking, bonsai, and telescope plans that used to structure my downtime.

duration.name: Duration
duration.manifestation: This low baseline has been going on since shortly after we moved into the older house, a little over two years ago.
